Project Development · Partnerships · Innovation
About

Development work that moves from idea to implementation.

I work at the intersection of project development, investment promotion, institutional coordination, and innovation. I enjoy identifying gaps, developing workable programs, bringing partners together, and helping translate ideas into systems, policies, or initiatives that can be sustained.

A project development and investment promotion professional with experience in designing and implementing regional programs, building partnerships across government, academe, business, and industry, and coordinating initiatives that support local economic development.

My work combines program development, stakeholder engagement, investment facilitation, creative economy development, startup and innovation support, and institutional strengthening.

“Building programs that make a difference.”

Selected Work

Programs and initiatives I helped build.

These are selected examples of work where I contributed to program development, coordination, institution building, policy support, and implementation.

01
Investment Promotion · LGU Investment Readiness

TRAIL Framework

Developed the Tracking Readiness and Assessment of Investment in LGUs (TRAIL) Framework to provide a more systematic way of assessing and strengthening LGU investment readiness in Region 02.

Outcome. DTI R2 and DILG R2 entered into a Joint Memorandum Circular adopting TRAIL as a regional mechanism for assessing LGU investment readiness in Cagayan Valley.

Public post ↗TRAIL Framework ↗
02
Investment Promotion · Export Development · Network Building

Cagayan Valley Export and Investment Network (CVEIN)

Contributed as one of the lead coordinators in the creation and establishment of CVEIN, a regional multi-institutional platform for stronger coordination on export and investment development.

Outcome. CVEIN was formally established with 26 partner institutions, with DTI R2 serving as Chair and Secretariat.

Public post ↗
03
Investment Promotion · Investor Servicing

Investor Engagement & Regional Promotion

Supported the promotion of Region 02 as an investment location through investor engagement, coordination of opportunities, and promotion of local investment and incentives codes among LGUs.

Outcome. Strengthened investor awareness of opportunities in Region 02 and supported continuing engagement between potential investors and regional stakeholders.

Public post 1 ↗Public post 2 ↗
04
Creative Industries · Local Policy Development

MITHI Ordinance

Designed the Malikhaing Industriya, Tangkilikin, Hubugin at Itaguyod (MITHI) Ordinance as a model policy to help LGUs institutionalize creative industries as a priority economic sector.

Outcome. As of July 2026, five LGUs had adopted the MITHI Ordinance.

Public post ↗MITHI Ordinance ↗
05
Creative Industries · Institution Building

Cagayan Valley Creative Industries Development Council

Led the creation of a regional council designed to strengthen coordination, representation, and collaborative development of the creative industries in Cagayan Valley.

Outcome. Established a formal regional platform for coordinated creative-industry development and stakeholder participation.

Public post ↗
06
Startup & Innovation · Program Development

HUSTLE Program

Conceptualized and developed HUSTLE — Holistic Uplifting of Startup Technopreneurs through Learning and Enablement — as a structured, multi-year startup development initiative for Region 02.

Outcome. Created a structured regional startup-development pipeline intended to strengthen and sustain the regional startup and innovation ecosystem.

Public post ↗Concept paper ↗
07
Competitiveness · Local Economic Development

CMCI & Local Competitiveness Support

Supported regional competitiveness initiatives, coordination, monitoring, and recognition efforts for participating LGUs.

Outcome. Four LGUs were recognized in the 2024 National CMCI Awarding, while 59 Most Competitive and Most Improved LGU awards were given to 33 LGUs during the regional Creative Local Governance Congress.

Note: The CMCI program was discontinued in 2025.

Public post ↗

Continuous Growth

Still learning. Still improving.

I believe professional growth is a continuous process. I remain committed to learning, adapting, and finding better ways to contribute as work, technology, and the needs of the people and institutions I serve continue to evolve.

I also recognize that the achievements reflected in this website are not mine alone. They are the result of the collective work, support, and trust of my colleagues, partners, and the institutions I have had the opportunity to work with.

Skills and experience matter, but I also believe that attitude, integrity, teamwork, openness to feedback, and the willingness to keep improving are just as important in creating meaningful and lasting work.
